decisions.reason: The superfood drink mix is a low-cost consumer line that builds on the firm's nutrient offering and still serves resellers, though it sits outside the core engineering focus.
Modular extensions to the waste-to-energy plants support the core decentralized energy business and cost little to keep listed.
The waste oil to energy plant has its own web page, which signals it is a flagship offering in the firm's core technology area.
Plastic-to-fuel fits the mission and draws on in-house prototyping, but it is only mentioned on the website, so commercial traction is uncertain.
